## Business Overview
M&D Parfum is a luxury perfume boutique that specializes in exclusive and artisan fragrances. This business sells the feeling of sophistication, exclusivity, and exceptional quality associated with high-end perfumes.

**Ideal Customer:** Affluent individuals who prioritize unique experiences over mass-market products; those seeking luxurious personal indulgence.
